services.name: Group Fitness
services.desc: We offer dozens of Group Fitness Classes within our Multi-Sport Location, in the Aquatics Center and at 77Training. Find an old favorite or try something new...we change and update our class schedule to adjust to the needs and desires of our members. Some options include: Yoga, Zumba, Interval Training, Mediation, Healthy Joints, Functional Training, Tai Chi, Yoga for Bone Health, Power Yoga and Cardio Strength and MORE! - Check out our “reality-ride” Spivi cycling classes! Or, check out the fitness possibilities in the water, such as: Aqua Power Deep, Aqua HIIT or Aqua Splash in our exercise pools.
